assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1).
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated to correlate symptoms with arrhythmic events and guide further management.
The payer's denial under CO-197 for missing precertification does not address the documented clinical necessity of the service.
